item.title: Pulumi Infrastructure as Code for Multi-Cloud Resource Management
item.description:
Pulumi Infrastructure as Code for Multi-Cloud Resource Management

Pulumi provides an infrastructure-as-code approach to build and deploy infrastructure across any architecture and cloud using known programming languages.

🔍 Overview

Pulumi allows users to provision and manage resources on AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, and over 300 other providers. It is open source under the Apache 2.0 license and is designed to be easy to extend.

🧩 How it works

Instead of using YAML, users write code in their favorite language, utilizing standard features such as:

  • Loops
  • Functions
  • Classes
  • Package management

⚙️ Key details

  • Automation API: Used to embed IaC anywhere.
  • Pulumi ESC: Used to manage configuration complexity and secrets sprawl securely across applications and cloud infrastructure.
  • Repository Components: The main repository includes the Pulumi CLI, language SDKs, and the core Pulumi engine, while individual libraries are maintained in their own repositories.

item.title: Pulumi Infrastructure as Code for Multi-Cloud Resource Management
item.description:
Pulumi Infrastructure as Code for Multi-Cloud Resource Management

Pulumi provides an infrastructure-as-code (IaC) approach to build and deploy infrastructure across any architecture and cloud using familiar programming languages.

🔍 Overview

Pulumi is an open source tool under the Apache 2.0 license that supports many clouds and languages. Its repository includes the core Pulumi engine, language SDKs, and the pulumi CLI, while individual libraries are maintained in separate repositories.

⚙️ Key details

  • Resource Management: Automatically provisions and manages resources on Kubernetes, Azure, AWS, Google Cloud Platform, and 300+ other providers.
  • Development Experience: Allows users to skip YAML in favor of standard language features such as classes, functions, loops, and package management.
  • Integration: Infrastructure as Code can be embedded anywhere using the Automation API.
  • Configuration: Pulumi ESC is used to manage configuration complexity and secrets sprawl securely across applications and cloud infrastructure.

#Pulumi #InfrastructureAsCode #CloudComputing #OpenSource

Source: pulumi/pulumi
